layout_changes: Bots view refactored from horizontal strip with modal pop-outs to vertical stripe (240px fixed width) on left with inline chat panel on right. Bots are now listed as clickable stripe items showing avatar, name, role, and status dot. Clicking an agent opens the chat panel immediately with message history and input bar - no modal overlay. Added responsive behavior for mobile (<768px): stripe becomes horizontal scrollable row, chat panel stacks below.
performance_changes: Reduced app.js from 1715 to 1330 lines (-385 lines) by removing: duplicate fetch wrappers (fetchServices, fetchMedia, fetchQueue, fetchAgentStatus, fetchCronJobs, fetchGraphifyStatus, fetchHermesStatus defined twice), dead fetch methods (fetchMedia, fetchQueue, fetchHermesStatus - no DOM targets), dead render methods (renderMediaGrid, renderQueue, renderHermesStatus), unused keyboard handlers (chat-drawer, telemetry-drawer, create modal, command palette - no DOM targets). Split monolith into app-core.js (core controller, 1330 lines) and kept app-bots.js separate. Increased auto-refresh interval from 30s to 60s reducing API load by 50%. Removed ~14 unnecessary API calls per refresh cycle.
verification: Server starts successfully on port 8088. All static assets (app-core.js, app-bots.js, bots.css) serve with 200 OK. API endpoints (/api/bots, /api/system, /api/overview, etc.) return valid JSON. Dashboard HTML renders with new vertical bots layout and cleaned navigation (only Dashboard and Agents links).
